# HOUZY by ACRONA AUDIO

> HOUZY is a mastering compressor plugin (VST3, AU) for any genre. It was born in electronic and dance music. Instead of one gain for the whole mix, it compresses every tone of the spectrum on its own, so a loud kick or bass does not pull the rest of the mix down with it (no pumping). Made by ACRONA AUDIO.

## Facts

- Product: HOUZY, version 5.0.0, released 17 October 2026.
- Type: mastering compressor audio plugin with a clipper and a limiter built in.
- Formats: VST3 on Windows; VST3 and AU on macOS (Universal: Apple Silicon and Intel), macOS build 5.0.1.
- Hosts: any DAW that loads VST3 (Ableton Live, FL Studio, Cubase, Reaper, Bitwig and others); AU for Logic Pro and GarageBand once the macOS build is out.
- Price: $69, one payment, a lifetime licence for two computers. Sold on Gumroad.
- Trial: 14 days free, every feature works during the trial.
- Free online demo: the real plugin interface in a web browser, on your own MP3 or WAV; the audio never leaves the browser.
- Audio stays on the user's computer; the plugin only goes online to activate the licence and to check for updates.
- Languages of the plugin and the site: English, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese.

## Technologies

- HOUZY engine: every tone gets its own envelope; there is no shared gain, so the mix cannot pump.
- ACR clipper: removes short peaks with a short cancelling pulse aimed under the kick instead of slicing the waveform.
- T8 limiter: changes gain only at zero crossings of the wave, so bass and kick are lowered without changing their shape. T6, a smooth six-band limiter, is also included.
- CYCLES / NOTE: attack is set in wave cycles of each tone, release in fractions of a bar (or milliseconds, with AUTO).
